name: harbor-bench
description: harbor-bench is a multimodal benchmark for perception and scene-understanding tasks in harbor/maritime environments. It evaluates models on detection, tracking, segmentation, and anomaly recognition under challenging conditions such as occlusion, clutter, and variable weather/lighting, using sensors typical to maritime/autonomous systems.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face; a niche dataset with limited but growing adoption in maritime and autonomous-vehicle perception research.
